text:
maya: Heads up — RC cut is tomorrow at 10:00 PDT. I want to pin the release version and ask for a quiet window starting 09:45. Any late-merge exceptions we should consider? :eyes:
jon: Got one — tiny docs-only tweak to the async API examples (PR #8427). CI green, only a markdown change. ok to cherry-pick? :thinking_face:
maya: Docs-only generally OK if CI passes and docs owner signs off. @sasha can you confirm ownership?
sasha: I can take ownership for this. Docs-only + no schema change = fine. Please target `release/rc-2026-03` branch and include "docs: backport example fix" in the changelog entry. :thumbsup:
liam: Quick question on version bump — the PR currently bumps to 1.5.0-rc. Should we do a patch bump (1.5.1-rc) or keep 1.5.0-rc? This is just bugfixes except the new telemetry flag which is behind a toggle.
maya: Keep 1.5.0-rc for the cut, we can increment post-rc if needed. Telemetry change is behind a flag so not a semver-minor.
jon: Confirming I'll cherry-pick and open a backport PR. Will include the changelog line as requested.
jon: quick note — for anyone doing the cherry-pick, use this snippet to avoid merge noise:
```bash
git checkout release/rc-2026-03
git fetch origin && git pull
git cherry-pick -x 8a9f3b2
# resolve conflicts if any, then push and open PR against release/rc-2026-03
```
ryan_oncall: Also flagging oncall for the window — if any infra flakiness shows up at cut time ping me immediately. I'm available 09:30-11:30 PDT.
release-bot: Release window lock scheduled at 2026-03-18T09:45:00-07:00. Any merges after that must go through the freeze-exceptions workflow: https://go/internal/release-freeze-exceptions
maya: Thanks everyone. If you have a late merge, post the PR link here and tag me. Otherwise let's keep the last 15 minutes quiet unless it's critical. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
